_comment: Occupant density informed by ASHRAE 62.1 Table 6-1 (warehouse ~2 people/1000 ft^2 -- sparse, bulk storage floor is mostly unoccupied) and DOE/NREL Commercial Reference Building Models (Deru et al. 2011) non-refrigerated Warehouse prototype (~52,000 ft^2, 1 floor, distinct office vs. bulk-storage schedule sets -- this repo models one blended occupant count, not separate zones). Illustrative, not survey-calibrated. gain_w_per_m2 (5 W/m^2) approximates ASHRAE 90.1 Table 9.5.1 non-refrigerated warehouse lighting power density (~0.66 W/ft^2 ~ 7.1 W/m^2), rounded down to reflect that most of a warehouse's floor area is sparse bulk storage with minimal equipment beyond lighting (this type does not model a separate refrigerated zone). Blended with (not replacing) the per-occupant gains -- see core/buem_adapter.py to_buem_profiles().
description: Warehouse / bulk storage with a small admin office. Weekday shift, closed weekends.
